name: cart-card
title: Add To Cart
description: A product card that is only a photo until you open it.
docs:
Add To Cart — A product card that is only a photo until you open it.

The stylesheet sits next to the component and is imported by it, so keep the two together in components/pinui/.

It is drawn in Inter. If your project does not already load that face it will fall back to your system sans and look noticeably different.

The photograph is not part of this package: `image` defaults to /library/shoe.jpg. Point it at your own product shot, or drop one at that path. It is multiplied onto the tile, so a plain white backdrop melts away on its own.
